name: THSV StreamBridge - Scene Gates
author: surakage
description: Two triggerless actions: Apply turns Streamer.bot commands on or off and hides or shows Twitch rewards when StreamBridge sees a scene change, and Check stops a Kick (or any other) action on the wrong scene with a chat reply.

kick: No triggers to add. For each Kick reward or command action you want to gate, add at the very top: Set Argument gateId (the gate name from the wizard), Run Action THSV Scene Gate - Check with Run Immediately ticked, then If/Else sceneGateAllowed equals False -> Break.

triggerSafety: Apply must remain triggerless: StreamBridge supplies a one-use broker token and only the gate changes. Check also has no trigger of its own; your own Kick (or other) actions run it with Run Action.
verificationStatus: Uses Streamer.bot's documented EnableCommand, DisableCommand, EnableReward, DisableReward, SetGlobalVar, GetGlobalVar, SendKickMessage, SendMessage and SendYouTubeMessageToLatestMonitored methods; live command and reward changes remain creator acceptance-tested.
